title: Block Busters — Neon Arena Web Demo
intro: Single focused browser demo. The previous multi-demo gallery is removed so Block Busters can look closer to the original desktop prototype.
note: The Play Demos section now loads Block Busters directly from assets/js/demos.js. This manifest is kept only as a readable reference for the current web demo.

demos.title: Block Busters
demos.summary: A focused neon block-arena web demo using original Block Busters pixel/block art where available.
demos.objective: Break blocks, grab powerups, outscore bots, and survive Gleebs dropping into the arena.
demos.controls: A/D or Arrows move, W/Up jump, G gravity flip, Space shockwave, Shift dash, R reset, P pause, M mute.
demos.details: Low-volume browser audio with a mute button. Uses original art assets with generated fallbacks.
